DROP PROCEDURE [OM].[SP_SFTP_FILE_DTL]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_SFTP_FILE_DTL] @item_name [varchar](150),@item_type [varchar](100),@last_modified [datetime],@size [numeric](38,4) AS

BEGIN

			INSERT INTO 
			[OM].[OM_SFTP_FILE_DTL] 
			(
				 [TABLE_NAME]
				,[ITEM_NAME]
				,[ITEM_TYPE]
				,[LAST_MODIFIED]
				,[SIZE]
				,[INSERT_DTTM]
			)
			SELECT  
				substring((substring(@item_name,7,len(@item_name)-6)),1,len(@item_name)-27)
				,@item_name
				,@item_type
				,@last_modified AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time'
				,@size
				,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)		
	
END

--GO
GO
